title: Ramayana
end_line: A Story of Courage, Love & Dharma — illustrated, for young readers
caption:
Your child can name 20 YouTubers. Can they tell you why Ram chose the forest over a throne?

The stories kids hear early become the values they carry. Ramayana on Pen A Story is illustrated, simple and written for young readers, so you can read it together at bedtime.
